title: Unit Event — Bout for Beside You — Episode7 All to Keep Moving Forward

meta.Episode: Episode7 — All to Keep Moving Forward
meta.Event Outline: Kohane has gained confidence and shown everyone a glimmer of her true potential. As happy as An is, she can't shake a growing feeling of unease. Meanwhile, the mysterious man who gave Kohane advice before makes an appearance before the group...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I know how I really feel now, but...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hey, An, good morning.
You're up early. You know you have today off, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know...
I couldn't fall back asleep.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Okay, in that case...
How does some French toast sound?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Really?
But you're always telling me to have breakfast at home.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I don't mind doing this every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yay...!
Then, I want extra powdered sugar!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I think Dad's really worried about me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Thanks to them, I was finally able to figure out what's been bothering me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I'm about to start practicing with Taiga! I'm nervous, but promise to do my best!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Dad.
After I'm done eating breakfast, I'm gonna go out and sing all day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So sorry, I won't be able to help out today...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Okay...
As a parent, I'd prefer it if you didn't stay out too late...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you seem pretty determined, so go sing your heart out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I last came to Vivid Street to sing.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane and I used to come here to help build her confidence, but now we're just holding team practices at the park.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (So that I can keep being Kohane's partner...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Okay, I feel good.
I'm hitting all the high notes.)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Huh? An, are you all alone today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
I decided to do some solo work today!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Oh, cool!
It's been a while since you sang solo like this. It's nice for a change.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You think so? Well, I'm gonna be here all day, so stick around and enjoy the show.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD's An's great and all, but seeing she's just as awesome flying solo is amazing too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(No, I can do better...
I need to be more patient to give the chorus more of an impact.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Okay, I'll do that for the next one...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Looks like An's singing on her own.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Yeah, that was perfect!
But this is what we normally...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Before, I could sing here without having anything bother me and always found a way to have fun.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But now, that feeling's weighing me down...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (At the same time, I never would've felt this way if I kept singing on my own...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I was able to discover how I feel because of everyone else... Because I have Kohane now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I just gotta accept it and keep singing...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks for listening, everyone!
My team will be doing another event soon, so be sure to come check us out!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
You're the best, An!
Come sing for us again!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
I love the way An sings!
It's like she knows exactly how to spice up everything!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I think I can finally move forward a little now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(That reminds me...
This is where I did my first street performance.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(It's such a nice spot too.
I can sing without worrying about much and people can gather without getting in the way of others.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Talk about a blast from the past. But it also feels like it happened just yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, this is where we're singing...?!
